title: Luxury Treatment Center | Kusnacht Practice
metaDescription: Kusnacht Practice is a world-leading private treatment centre in Switzerland, specialising in mental health, addiction, and behavioural disorders. Located on the shores of Lake Zurich, we offer a highly personalised, evidence-based approach delivered by a multidisciplinary team of internationally recognised clinicians.

The world-renowned private treatment center dedicated to mental health and addiction in Zurich, Switzerland.
YOUR FUTURE IS YOURS TO SHAPE

Because we believe in your potential, we want to guide you towards a life filled with meaning, balance, and lasting renewal. Expect exceptional care grounded in both science and compassion.

TREATMENTS FOR

YOUR HEALING IS PERSONAL. SO IS OUR APPROACH.

Wherever you stand, we meet you there. Our programmes are built around you. We go beyond symptom management to find the root causes. With a team of leading medical experts, we combine advanced mental health treatment with physical restoration and holistic support. Every detail is designed to help you live not just longer, but more fully. The goal is clarity, vitality, and renewed purpose.

DISCOVER MORE

WHERE PRECISION MEETS COMPASSION

DISCOVER

BIO-R® METHOD FOR

REJUVENATION & LONGEVITY
DISCOVER
MEDICAL EXCELLENCE. DEDICATED IN-HOUSE TEAM.

Your treatment journey at Kusnacht Practice is managed by our unified, in-house team of specialists. By integrating evidence-based care with the latest advancements in psychotherapy, medical treatments, and longevity science, this collaborative approach ensures you receive the highest possible chance for recovery, healing and prevention. Our team works closely with your existing doctors to achieve best-in-class care. At Kusnacht Practice we have more doctors than clients.

UNCOMPROMISING PRIVACY FOR HEALING

Total privacy and discretion encompass everything we do. From the very first contact with Kusnacht Practice to treatment and continuing care, we ensure you remain anonymous. Each client is treated in one of our 10 luxury villas located around residential areas overlooking lake Zurich. These villas are designed to be true sanctuaries for healing, fully discreet, with no exterior signage or branding. Your in-villa team is hand-selected for their professionalism and warmth. From your live-in-counsellor, chef, chauffeur, housekeeping to personal trainer - they all play a central role in your day-to-day recovery.

START YOUR JOURNEY

YOUR PATH TO HEALING STARTS HERE

Understanding that every journey is unique, we ensure your first step is met with unparalleled discretion and genuine care. Our dedicated team is here to listen, understand, and guide you toward a program crafted exclusively for your needs, in an environment designed for profound healing.
